niche_preference_profile: This user prefers screens that feel complete, structured, and information-rich, with clear hierarchy, visible actions, and enough content to avoid looking empty or unfinished. They generally like lighter, airier, more polished layouts with strong section grouping and scannable rows, but they also sometimes prefer darker, higher-contrast alert states when the screen is about a serious card-status issue. They favor explicit labels, concrete status details, and prominent primary actions over vague or placeholder-like UI.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that show populated, finished-looking content with enough visible items, settings, or details to feel complete rather than blank or placeholder-like.
Prefers strong section grouping, clear top-to-bottom flow, and distinct visual hierarchy that makes the screen easy to scan and understand.
Prefers obvious, easy-to-find primary actions such as clear buttons or controls that stand out from the rest of the interface.
Prefers lists and rows that include specific identifying details like names, phone numbers, avatars, labels, or status cues.
Prefers layouts that use space efficiently and feel filled out, but still remain balanced and not overly cramped or chaotic.
Prefers per-item actions and clearly presented controls, especially when each row has an obvious function such as unblock, delete, info, or toggle.
Prefers modular screens with clearly separated sections or cards that organize content into understandable chunks.
Prefers concise, task-focused copy that states the status or next step clearly instead of vague, generic, or overly verbose wording.
